terms.comment: Only of animals, snakes and worms and the like; rēpō is said of people too, as of a crawling baby (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: repo · Lewis & Short: serpo

phrases.latin: serpere anguiculōs, nāre anaticulās, ēvolāre merulās
phrases.english: little snakes crawl, ducklings swim, blackbirds fly off
